summary.text: Son of Canethus or Abas, Argonaut killed in Libya on the return while raiding flocks.

story.text: Apollonius names Canthus among the crew; Hyginus says he was slain in Libya by the shepherd Cephalion when pillaging sheep.
Apollonius sends him from Euboea and names Cerinthus as the city he would not return to, once fate had ordained that he and Mopsus should perish in the furthest ends of Libya.
